source.pinned_baseline_rationale: Phase-3 Linux SOURCE_SHA (verified upstream commit used for patch series P3-FINAL-R3, MIOpen 3.6.2). Historical preparation anchor ONLY - the final Phase-5.1 base will come from findings/phase5_1/FINAL_HANDOFF.json and MUST NOT be assumed to equal this SHA.
source.acquisition: codeload.github.com tarball at exact SHA (132 bytes->1.2GB verified gzip), extracted to source/upstream-pristine; git blobless clone running in background (scripts/clone_loop.sh) for future worktree operations

build_prerequisites.cxx_compiler: 7.14.1 SDK llvm amdclang++ (AMD clang 22.0.0git roc-7.2.1-based LLVM; HIP 7.14.60850)
build_prerequisites.notes: gitlab.com (Eigen upstream URL) black-holed via proxy - system package used instead with identical version 3.4.0; FunctionalPlus fetch failed twice via flaky proxy - tarballs pre-seeded locally with SHA256 verification

config.MIOPEN_USE_COMPOSABLEKERNEL: OFF (mirrors Phase-3 Linux config; CK not needed for kthvalue path)

contamination_incidents_and_fixes: MIOPEN_AMDGCN_ASSEMBLER + MIOPEN_OFFLOADBUNDLER_BIN initially resolved to /opt/rocm/llvm/bin (7.2.1) via find_program PATHS hints; caught by mandatory CMakeCache grep; fixed by explicit cache pins to 7.14.1 SDK llvm

post_review_fixes.G04_subagent_MAJOR_1: Under env_rocm7141.sh alone, wheel libMIOpen.so.1 (MIOpen 3.5.2, _rocm_sdk_libraries) shadowed the source build via LD_LIBRARY_PATH precedence over driver RUNPATH; MIOpenDriver --version reported 3.5.2. FIXED: scripts/run_validation_leg.sh prepends the leg install/lib to LD_LIBRARY_PATH AND LD_PRELOADs the leg's libMIOpen.so.1 soname symlink. Corrected proof in logs/G04_mioopen_driver_version.log: MIOpen (version: 3.6.2), ldd shows libMIOpen.so.1 -> install/baseline/lib, hiprtc/amdhip64 -> 7.14.1 wheel core.
post_review_fixes.G04_subagent_MAJOR_2: Venv SDK devel/bin ships its own MIOpenDriver earlier in PATH. Rule: always invoke drivers/harness by ABSOLUTE path (encoded in all runner scripts).
post_review_fixes.additional_verification: Independent reviewer verified all 8032/8032 files of source/upstream-pristine hash-identical to pinned commit b68f894 using the blobless clone's tree objects (fin/ is a submodule gitlink, empty dir in tarball - expected).
